title: Mechanistic Data Attribution: Tracing the Training Origins of Interpretable LLM Units
abstract: Mechanistic Data Attribution (MDA) traces interpretable LLM units, such as induction heads, previous-token heads, and SAE features, back to influential training samples. It replaces global loss-based training data attribution with unit-specific influence functions computed over target parameter subspaces and approximated with EK-FAC. Counterfactual retraining on Pythia models shows that deleting or augmenting high-influence samples delays or accelerates circuit emergence, repetitive structural data such as LaTeX/XML acts as a catalyst for induction heads, and intervention on induction-head formation causally co-varies with in-context learning.
